test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 5 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of Interest (r) = 7% per year

Time (t) = 5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P × r × t}{100}

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{3000 × 7 × 5}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{105000}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹1050

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
